note: 7u (trustworthy, buffer-leftover fixed): the netemu-partition drive read is characterized. Metadata works — GET CONFIGURATION=DVD-ROM (0x10), READ CAPACITY=nonzero. But READ(10) content returns SUCCESS status + 0 bytes + NO sense error (both PIO and DMA). Not a dead DMA path (small data-ins work), not a standard auth error (sense clean). = PS2-disc content gate: drive serves metadata, withholds sector content over generic ATAPI. A+B irrelevant. Viable route = Cobra-feeds-netemu (GameOS does the unlock, feeds sectors). See docs/FIRMWARE_ROUTE_READ_CORRECTION.md.
